dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study utilized Dataset 1 (Cam-CAN) for normative model training, Dataset 2 (MCAD) for subtyping patients with AD and MCI, and Dataset 3 (ADNI) for replication and longitudinal analysis of MCI subtypes. Healthy controls from all three datasets were included in the overall analysis.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Dataset 1 was used to build the normative models. Dataset 2 provided the primary clinical cohort (AD, MCI, and NC) for subtyping. Dataset 3 provided an independent cohort (MCI and NC) for robustness validation and longitudinal conversion risk analysis. NC from Datasets 2 and 3 served to adjust for site-specific baseline deviations.

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A total of 1160 healthy controls (NC) were used across the study (644 from Dataset 1, 257 from Dataset 2, and 259 from Dataset 3). The training of the Gaussian process regression models was performed specifically on the 644 healthy individuals from Dataset 1.
